description: Shared schema foundation: add the client.is_demo column (Flyway migration + mirrored on BOTH xamops and billops Client entities), add ClientRepository.findFirstByDemoTrue(), and seed one idempotent shared read-only 'Demo Workspace' demo client in DataInitializer. This is the foundation every other FEAT depends on (gates, provisioning, and the billops demo-users query all read Client.demo). Must land first. Independent of FEAT-005 (frontend/nginx) but required before FEAT-002/003/004.
steps: Add the demo boolean to the xamops Client entity at /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/.worktrees/demo-xamops-host/xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/domain/Client.java, following the sibling booleans (starred, smsNotificationsEnabled): `@Column(name = "is_demo", nullable = false, columnDefinition = "boolean default false") private boolean demo = false;`. The class is Lombok @Data, so isDemo()/setDemo(boolean) are generated — do NOT add a manual accessor. Field name MUST be `demo` (so Spring Data derives property `demo`).

Mirror the identical column on the billops Client entity at /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/.worktrees/demo-xamops-host/billops/src/main/java/com/xammer/billops/domain/Client.java (also @Data) so the two mappings do not drift under ddl-auto=update. Same annotation and field name `demo`.

Create the Flyway migration (new file) /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/.worktrees/demo-xamops-host/xamops-service/src/main/resources/db/migration/V20261016_1__client_is_demo.sql with exactly: `ALTER TABLE client ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_demo BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE;`. The name sorts strictly after the latest existing migration V20261015_2__user_activity_tracking.sql.

Add ONLY `Optional<Client> findFirstByDemoTrue();` to /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/.worktrees/demo-xamops-host/xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/repository/ClientRepository.java. Do NOT re-declare `Optional<Client> findByName(String)` — it already exists as the first method (used by GoogleAuthController.uniqueClientName); re-adding it is a duplicate declaration that fails to compile the whole module.

Add an idempotent createDemoClientIfMissing() step to DataInitializer.run(...) at /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/.worktrees/demo-xamops-host/xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/config/DataInitializer.java, placed AFTER the existing default-client/superadmin/demo-user seeding (do not alter those steps). Logic: if clientRepository.findFirstByDemoTrue().isPresent() return (idempotent by flag); else clientRepository.findByName("Demo Workspace").ifPresentOrElse(existing -> { existing.setDemo(true); save; log }, () -> { Client demo = new Client("Demo Workspace"); demo.setDemo(true); save; log }). Reuse the existing logger field. This name-collision guard avoids violating the UNIQUE constraint on Client.name.

AC-16: the migration file name is strictly later than V20261015_2 and follows V<YYYYMMDD>_<seq>__description.sql.
AC-14: DataInitializer seeds exactly one 'Demo Workspace' client with is_demo=true and is idempotent (re-run creates no duplicate).
AC-15: the two pre-existing demo users keep their defaultClient association (their seeding is unchanged).
xamops-service compiles and context loads with no PropertyReferenceException (field is `demo`, so findFirstByDemoTrue resolves).
verification: From /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/.worktrees/demo-xamops-host run `mvn test -B --no-transfer-progress -pl xamops-service -am` — module compiles, context loads, existing suite (including any DataInitializer/boot test) passes.
From the same dir run `mvn test -B --no-transfer-progress -pl billops -am` — billops Client entity change compiles and the billops suite passes (confirms no drift between the two Client mappings).
git -C /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/.worktrees/demo-xamops-host commit the changed/new files locally on feature/demo-xamops-host (never push).
findings: Schema foundation landed and both suites green (xamops-service + billops BUILD SUCCESS). SEMANTICS for later FEATs: (1) The shared demo client is identified by Client.demo == true (DB column client.is_demo, BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE). Read it via ClientRepository.findFirstByDemoTrue() (returns Optional<Client>). (2) The seeded demo client NAME is exactly 'Demo Workspace' (not an email) — created/marked idempotently by DataInitializer.createDemoClientIfMissing(), which runs AFTER the superadmin + demo-user seeding. Its id is DB-generated (IDENTITY), not fixed; resolve by flag, never by hardcoded id. (3) Idempotency is by the is_demo flag first, then a findByName('Demo Workspace') name-collision guard that flips an existing same-named row to demo=true instead of inserting (avoids the UNIQUE(name) violation). (4) demo field is mirrored on BOTH Client entities (com.xammer.cloud.domain.Client in xamops-service and com.xammer.billops.domain.Client in billops) with identical @Column(name="is_demo", nullable=false, columnDefinition="boolean default false") private boolean demo = false; — @Data generates isDemo()/setDemo(boolean). (5) Migration filename: V20261016_1__client_is_demo.sql (sorts after V20261015_2). The two pre-existing demo users (demo.xamops@xammer.in, demo.billops@xammer.in) are UNCHANGED and still keep their Default Client association — the demo client is separate from their defaultClient.
